The '''Cool Respite''' was a region of the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] that was located south of [[Outpost Zaroshe]]. It was an area often frequented by the [[Exchange]] to stockpile [[Spice/Legends|spice]]. The Exchange warlord [[Ghar Bodya]] was assassinated here on behalf of [[Shayl Tasao]], who wanted to negotiate a deal with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] to no longer seek retribution on the Exchange due to Bodya's attacks on Imperial assets.

==Behind the scenes==
Cool Respite first appeared as part of the Tatooine map in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying video game]] released by [[BioWare]].
